name: Onozaki Hiyori
source: She has excellent grades and is a good athlete. She is also well versed in martial arts, and is so strong that she can easily subdue a grown man. In addition, she has a mature beauty that makes people think she is unapproachable, but her personality is ladylike, friendly, and mischievous, and she has the characteristics of a schoolgirl of her age.
